source_sql: SELECT DISTINCT res.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, sec.sectionId AS sectionId FROM Section sec JOIN edge ownership ON ownership.src_id=sec.node_id AND ownership.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ownership.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id JOIN edge modification ON modification.dst_id=hub.node_id AND modification.rel_type='MODIFIES' JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=modification.src_id JOIN edge mention ON mention.dst_id=cr.node_id AND mention.rel_type='REFERENCES' JOIN Resolution res ON res.node_id=mention.src_id JOIN edge release_scope ON release_scope.src_id=cr.node_id AND release_scope.rel_type='TARGET_RELEASE' JOIN Release target ON target.node_id=release_scope.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND edition.specRelease=target.releaseName AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected)<>'' AND declared_section_matches(cr.clausesAffected,sec.sectionNumber)=1
